description: This file defines the Twig\Token class, which represents tokens in the Twig templating engine. It includes token type constants, properties for token data, and methods for token testing, string representation, and type name conversions.

classes.name: Twig\Token
classes.description: Represents a token in the Twig template parsing process, with methods to access token properties and to identify token types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new token instance with type, value, and line number.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Tests whether the token matches a specified type and/or value.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Returns the line number where the token was found.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the token.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the token.

methods.name: typeToString
methods.description: Converts a token type constant to its string representation.

methods.name: typeToEnglish
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the token type.
